name: openbb_insider_trading
description:
Insider (officer, director, 10% owner) transactions from Form 4 filings through the OpenBB Platform (obb.equity.ownership.insider_trading).
Returns: {symbol, provider, data_points, truncated, transactions: [records with filing and transaction dates, owner, type, shares, price]} or {symbol, error}.
Inputs (* required): symbol*; limit (transactions; default 20); provider (fmp, intrinio, sec; default sec).
Other sources: yf_insider_transactions, edgar_insider_transactions. Keys: sec needs none; fmp uses SAJHA's FMP_API_KEY; intrinio needs a key in ~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json.
Example: {"symbol": "TSLA", "limit": 10}
